Scar: An Overseer of the Fractsidus and the first of them to take an interest in Rover. He believes people should give in to what the Lament made of them.
Bell-Borne Geochelone: An ancient turtle-like Tacet Discord that carries a great bell on its shell.
Dreamless: A Threnodian's herald formed at the front beyond Jinzhou. Rover and Jiyan drove it back in the first chapter.
Sentinel Jué: The Sentinel of Jinzhou, a dragon that commands time. It tests those it has chosen on Mt. Firmament.
Hecate: A nightmare that feeds on dreams, met in the inverted tower of Avinoleum.
Fleurdelys: The knight Cartethyia was raised to become, given a will of its own.
Threnodian Leviathan: The Threnodian that fed on Rinascita's faith for generations.
Denia: The Startorch student whose file lists the Fractsidus. As a challenge she shows what she was hiding.
